title: chat-server: outbound seams for receipt, typing and presence
description: Seam gap (additive, but blocks the JMAP-lrgt acceptance claim that seams suffice for federation). OutboundEvent (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/outbound.rs) covers Retract, Edit and GroupUpdate; JMAP-5mz6.7 adds reactions and new Messages. Still missing: (a) outbound Peer/receipt when the owner sets readAt (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 §Peer/receipt Sender Behavior L470-472; chat-00 L945 receiptSharing suppression); (b) Chat/typing: handle_chat_typing (chat.rs ~L1365-1394) validates and returns with no hook, so neither local WS fan-out nor outbound Peer/typing can learn a typing event without re-registering the Chat/typing handler; (c) outbound Peer/presence on PresenceStatus/set change for subscribed peers (federation §Peer/subscribePresence Behavior L706). Add non_exhaustive OutboundEvent variants (or one defaulted hook) and emit them; no required method or signature change needed. Inbound handlers are JMAP-v9py.15.5.
